claims.claim_text: Engineering executive builds governed agentic AI platform architecture, embedding release resilience and security discipline into delivery paths for regulated modernization programs.
The platform's control-plane design coordinates policy-gated agent execution and route-level dispatch decisions into one governed runtime.
Tool sandbox egress boundaries constrain agent actions so autonomous execution stays within defined policy limits.
Dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, strengthening the platform's operating model and productization path toward IP-led revenue growth.
Human override and escalation paths together with runtime proof-bundle lineage sustain auditable, traceable execution across the platform.
That operating foundation generated $22M in IP-led revenue while scaling the platform engineering team, positioning the organization for continued enterprise-scale deployment and productization.
